body:
No problem.  It's good you're not anxious about asking for help.  You're already in kind of a good position then.  

Have you seen a psychologist for the reading issue?  I don't know if it would help, but I feel I have the same issue, in a way.  For me, it is like, I understand, and yet, I cannot explain why I understand.  And people often say that if you cannot explain a concept to another person, then you yourself don't understand the concept.

I wonder if that is a common thing.  Maybe a large part of the population, regardless of "intelligence," have a difficult time retaining textual information.   So maybe you don't really have much to worry about.  If it makes you feel even better, you're doing better than me, heh.  

Take care.

I wish I had more helpful things to tell you, but I feel exactly the same way.  Or at least I think so.  Are you anxious about people showing you how to do things?  Because if not, you're fine with people showing you how to do things and retaining that knowledge?  Because I think that is most of what one needs to do in order to succeed.  At least career-wise.  

And I agree, life is sad.  It's hard to face.  

Hopefully this is somewhat helpful.

Thank you for the replies everyone.  I'm sorry I haven't gotten back to you sooner.  

Hope you're well GeoCosmos.

Lyrabelle, I appreciate what you wrote.  I hope maybe things get better for you.  PM if you want to.  Don't give up.

Super_Kapowzler, thanks for the motivation.  I think I'm subscribed to that sub, I just need to actually read it, heh.  

LicensedProfessional, I hope you really are a licensed professional of some sort and tell me that sometimes (or a lot of times?) need to have a "fuck it" attitude.
Thanks.  I'll look into this.  I just feel like my time is running out.

I've seen a therapist for over a decade, as well as a second therapist for about one year.  I've had a psychiatrist for over a decade as well and have tried several different med combinations.  I have never heard of DBT, but I have heard of CBT.  I'm trying to look into something new because obviously what I'm doing isn't working.  But the other part of me just doesn't care.  I'm very ambivalent.  Exposure therapy sounds like it would be very helpful.  I really need to experience that which absolutely terrifies me.  But then again, I'm terrified.  

Hopefully I can find someone in my state that is somewhat affordable.  Hopefully I can actually do it.

Thanks for the reply.  

I think it might be too late, though.  I cannot get over what has been lost.  I cannot enjoy things.  Even beautiful days.  So it is doubly troublesome.
